news.title: Americans' debt problems are flashing a warning not seen since the Great Recession
news.description: Researchers found that while wealth disparities narrowed somewhat, the ability to meet debt payments deteriorated significantly.

news.title: Tanker attacks in Strait of Hormuz surge to wartime high as Iran tries to choke off oil exports
news.description: The escalating attacks are testing whether a rebound in crude oil exports from the Middle East can be sustained under high-risk conditions.

news.title: Trump Media advisor Katie Zacharia offered White House press secretary role
news.description: The White House has tapped Katie Zacharia to be its next press secretary, a White House official confirmed to CNBC.
